data.case_title: Rejection of building permit application (Bauantrag) for a carport
data.explanation: The Landratsamt (district building authority) refused your application to build a carport with a storage room because the plot lies in an officially designated flood-risk area of the Inn river, where new buildings are normally not allowed and no exception applies here. A Widerspruch (objection) is not available in this matter; instead you may decide whether to challenge the decision by filing a lawsuit (Klage) with the administrative court, and the app will show you until when. Separately, you will receive another notice charging a €120 processing fee, which is due even though the application was refused. If you want to contest the rejection, consider consulting a lawyer specialised in building/planning law.

items.title: Decide whether to file a court action (Klage) against the rejection
items.action: If you disagree with the rejection, you may file a lawsuit (Klage) with the Bayerisches Verwaltungsgericht Musterregensburg, in writing or by declaration to the court's registry
items.consequence: If you miss the deadline shown, the rejection becomes final and binding

date.text: binnen eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe

items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie binnen eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Klage beim Bayerischen Verwaltungsgericht Musterregensburg, Haidplatz 4, 93047 Musterregensburg erheben, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Geschäftsstelle des Gerichts.

items.title: Expect a separate fee notice (Kostenbescheid) of €120
items.action: Wait for the separate fee notice (Kostenbescheid) for the rejection and pay the €120 once it arrives

data.summary: The Landratsamt Musterinn (Bauamt – Untere Bauaufsichtsbehörde) rejected Kathrin Musterreiter's building application (Bauantrag) for a carport with a storage room on plot Fl.-Nr. 88/14, because the site lies in the designated flood-risk area (Überschwemmungsgebiet) of the Inn river. A separate €120 fee notice will follow, and a lawsuit (Klage) may be filed with the administrative court within one month of notification.
